rubric.visuals: athlete readability (not stick/block); whole pitch framing; animation; stadium depth; ball visibility; wicket impact; sports-game feel
rubric.gameplay: line/length measurable; reverse/conventional; batter reaction; bowled/lbw/beaten for the right reasons; challenges
rubric.controls: sliders AND keyboard; chips selected; bowl/pause/replay; aim vs pitched
rubric.polish: responsive layout; no console errors; 60fps-ish; sound toggle

learned_from: Cricket 24 / Big Ant — bowler's-end broadcast camera, impact cut on wickets
Don Bradman Cricket — length buttons, coloured pitch marker
WCC / Real Cricket — on-pitch landing grid and sports HUD
Broadcast LBW — pad flash, hawk-eye would-hit, umpire finger

quality_pass.notes: Articulated kit and stadium depth landed, but wicket climax stayed on the wide bowler-end frame so smash/pad/finger read small. No on-canvas call stamp.
Crease close-up, square-leg umpire finger, shin pads, smashed stumps. Sight-screen quad looked like a broken overlay. HTML call easy to miss.
Removed sight-screen artifact. Canvas BOWLED/LBW/BEATEN stamps. Stumps scatter, pad WOULD HIT, mute + onboarding. Still stylized mannequin athletes — not photoreal.
